A package: a setup in one file. It never holds secrets, credentials,
tokens, member lists or content beyond what its author put in.

Your own id for this activity, unique within the run. Sending it
again is counted as a duplicate, never an error, so a retried batch

kind.description:
run_started, run_finished, run_error, step_started, step_finished,
text_message, reasoning, tool_call, plan, state_snapshot,
state_delta, interrupt, interrupt_resolved, usage, result, gap or
custom.

parentRef.description: The activity it is under, your own name for it.

payload.description:
A JSON object, by kind: run_finished {outcome: done, failed or
cancelled}; text_message and reasoning {text}; tool_call {toolCallRef,
tool, status, ...}, the same toolCallRef for every report of one call;
plan {items: [{title, status}]}, the whole list each time; interrupt
{request: {kind: question or approval, title, detail?, options?:
[{id, label, style?}], allowText?, audience?: {accounts, roles},
clientRequestId?, expiresInSeconds?}}, which opens a request, or
{requestId}; interrupt_resolved {requestId}; gap {reason}. At most
48 KiB; secrets are removed.

stepRef.description: The step it belongs to, your own name for it.

summary.description: One line to show for it. Made from the payload when left out.

conversationId.description:

messageId.description: The message that asked for it (id or link). Needed for message.

ref.description:

liveness.description: ok, quiet (no report for one interval) or not_responding (three).

post.description: Report what a run you opened did, up to 100 activities a call: steps, tool calls, the plan, messages, reasoning, gaps, interrupts and run_finished (payload.outcome done, failed or cancelled, which finishes the run). Each has your own id; sending it again counts as a duplicate, so retry a whole batch freely. Secrets are removed before anything is stored. An interrupt that asks people something needs requests.raise. Needs "Report their own runs" where it acts.

Activities refused because the run reached its limit of 20,000; one

request tools, or report interrupt_resolved when you no longer wait.

post.description: Ask a run to stop. A run still queued is cancelled at once; one that's going shows cancel_requested until the agent doing it confirms (it hears run.cancel, or loses its claim on the request it answers), and a stop nobody confirms ends it after ten minutes. A run on the built-in host stops as its Stop button does. Asking again changes nothing. Needs "Stop runs" where it acts.

post.description: Open a run for your own work so people can follow it: what you're doing, why (cause: a task, thread, message, schedule, trigger, automation, request or by hand) and how often you'll report. Pass a clientRunId and a retry returns the same run (created: false). Then report with run_activity_report (steps, tool calls, plan, messages, run_finished), run_usage_report, run_result_report and run_update. Needs "Report their own runs" where it acts.

Your own id for this run, unique among your runs. Opening again with
the same one returns the run you already opened (created: false), so
a retry never makes a second run.

parentRunId.description: A run of yours in the same space this one is part of.

reportIntervalSeconds.description:
How often you promise to report, in seconds (30 to 86,400; default
900). A run silent for one interval shows as quiet, for three as not
responding.

settings.description:
What the run was started with (a JSON object of at most 16 KiB).
Fixed once set; secrets are removed.

spaceId.description: The space the run is in: its id, link or key (such as "AWD").

working (the default) or accepted, for a run that hasn't started
